summary.title: SemComp-Bench: Benchmarking Semantic Task Completion in Video Generation

details: Existing video generation benchmarks score fidelity, temporal coherence, subject consistency and physical plausibility, but do not test whether a generated video actually achieves an instructed outcome while staying semantically grounded in the reference image.

Proposes 'Semantic Task Completion Video Generation': an outcome-oriented formulation where success requires the intended completed state plus preservation of task-relevant reference semantics, with no need to show intermediate steps or maintain pixel-level appearance consistency.

SemComp-Data: an evaluation dataset of (reference image, brief + detailed instruction, outcome-centric video clip) triplets mined from full-context real-world videos so that reference and outcome come from the same real task instance, guaranteeing feasibility and genuine attribute alignment; built by a scalable four-stage VLM pipeline (Candidate Filtering, State Mining, Video Extension, Instruction Structuring).

SemComp-Bench: an evaluation protocol in which a VLM answers structured, evidence-grounded binary questions over uniformly sampled frames, aggregated into an OA Score (conjunctive pass over outcome realization, semantic grounding, grounded entity consistency, global visual continuity) and a GR Score (mean over five reliability criteria).
Source pool: ~20K videos randomly sampled from Koala-36M; title-based keyword filtering (45 case-sensitive strings covering news/movie/entertainment) removes narration-dependent videos.
VLM categorizes 'video abstract' mosaics into 6 domains and 21 fine-grained categories (e.g. Dish Making, Blueprint Construction, Sculpting); 'Uncertain' videos discarded.

State Mining localizes reference/outcome timestamps against manually written category-specific state definitions, then a QA-based consistency check discards pairs where the VLM cannot unambiguously pick the outcome frame.
Video Extension uses Panda-70M-style shot detection plus same-scene merging around the verified timestamp; clips are >=3s, mean 4.03s.

Instruction Structuring: brief instruction capped at 30 words with template [Verb]+[Subject]+[Preposition]+[State]; detailed instruction adds one of 4 alignment types (Object Element, Person Identity, Object Appearance, Scene) plus preserve/discard attributes from a 17-attribute vocabulary.
Yield: 1,273 instances; SemComp-Core evaluation subset of 60 (10 per domain, stratified to preserve alignment-type distribution).
27 frames uniformly sampled per generated video, presented in temporal order; evaluator must answer yes/no and cite visual evidence.

OA: 4 criteria, conjunctive (all must pass); failure-oriented questions pass on 'no'. GR: 5 criteria (physical plausibility, visual clarity, artifact-free rendering, within-scene spatiotemporal coherence, text/interface integrity), averaged.
Judge VLM: Doubao-Seed-1.8 via Volcano Engine API; each video scored by 3 independent VLM calls at different times, results averaged (standard deviations reported in supplement).
Open-source: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B, Wan2.2-I2V-A14B, CogVideoX1.5-5B-I2V, SkyReels-V2-I2V-14B-720P, HunyuanVideo-1.5-720P-I2V, Phantom-1.3B; closed-source: Seedance 2.0.
One 720p video per instance, official/default inference configs, fixed seed where controllable.
Conditioning study on Wan2.2-A14B, CogVideoX1.5-5B, HunyuanVideo-1.5-720P: I2V+detailed vs T2V+detailed vs T2V+brief, with matched parameter-scale checkpoints.
Qualitative side-by-side comparisons of all seven models on shared reference + detailed instruction across categories such as Sculpting, Artwork Creation, Restoration, Food Transformation.

key_findings.finding: Semantic task completion is far from solved: no evaluated model exceeds 40% joint outcome achievement.
key_findings.evidence: On SemComp-Core with detailed instructions, HunyuanVideo-1.5-720P-I2V leads with an OA Score of 37.8%, Wan2.2-I2V-A14B 28.3%, Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 23.3%, Seedance 2.0 20.0%, CogVideoX1.5-5B-I2V 14.4%, Phantom-1.3B 3.9%.

key_findings.finding: Outcome achievement and generation reliability are largely decoupled, so quality-oriented metrics do not predict task completion.
key_findings.evidence: Seedance 2.0 has the best GR Score (91.8%) but only 20.0% OA, while HunyuanVideo-1.5-720P-I2V has the best OA (37.8%) with a GR of 79.1%; Seedance also leads outcome realization (0.839) and semantic grounding (0.744) yet is dragged down by grounded entity consistency (0.444) and global visual continuity (0.594).

key_findings.finding: Models exhibit complementary failure profiles: strength in reaching the instructed state trades off against outcome-video validity.
key_findings.evidence: Wan2.2-TI2V-5B tops grounded entity consistency (0.689) and global visual continuity (0.922) but is weak on outcome realization (0.589) and semantic grounding (0.400), the inverse pattern to Seedance 2.0; qualitatively, models often preserve reference appearance and depict the process without reaching the outcome.

key_findings.finding: Reference-image conditioning is indispensable, mainly for semantic grounding and outcome-video validity rather than for reaching the outcome itself.
key_findings.evidence: Across all three model families, I2V beats T2V under detailed instructions (Wan2.2 28.3% vs 4.4%; CogVideoX1.5 14.4% vs 5.0%; HunyuanVideo 37.8% vs 4.4%), driven by global visual continuity (e.g. 0.789 vs 0.117 for Wan2.2), while T2V outcome realization is comparable or even higher (0.889 vs 0.800 for Wan2.2).
